blocks.content: The logical operators allow you to combine multiple conditions, which is useful in many situations. For example,

items: Checking if a person qualifies for a loan if their credit score is above 700 and they have an annual salary greater than $6000.
Checking if a customer is eligible for a discount if their purchase is over a certain amount or if they have a membership.
Check if a person is eligible to vote.
